title: Accounts Assistant
description:
We are delighted to be working with a successful and growing business that is looking to appoint an experienced Accounts Assistant.

This is a varied, hands-on role covering the full range of transactional finance. It would suit someone with a strong grounding in accounts who also has some payroll experience and enjoys taking ownership of their work.

Working as part of a small collaborative finance team, your responsibilities will include:
- Managing the purchase ledger, including processing invoices and supplier payments
- Raising sales invoices and maintaining the sales ledger
- Completing bank and credit card reconciliations
- Processing employee expenses
- Resolving supplier and customer account queries
- Supporting credit control and monitoring outstanding balances
- Assisting with payroll preparation and processing
- Maintaining accurate employee and payroll records
- Supporting month-end processes, including reconciliations and journal preparation
- Ensuring finance records are complete, accurate and kept up to date
- Providing wider support to the finance team as required

The successful candidate will:
- Have previous experience in a broad transactional finance role
- Have some practical payroll experience
- Be comfortable managing both purchase and sales ledger activities
- Demonstrate excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Be organised and able to manage competing priorities
- Communicate confidently with colleagues, customers and suppliers
- Have good Excel skills and experience using accounting software

If you are an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you

title: Billing & Finance Assistant
description:
Join a growing organisation and support high-volume AP, AR, billing, reconciliations and payment processing within a fast-paced finance team. This is a hybrid Leeds-based opportunity on a initial 6-month FTC with strong permanent potential, and the chance to play a key role in the company's ongoing finance transformation journey.

Client Details

This professional services organisation is based in Leeds.

Description

You'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day finance operation, with responsibilities including:
- Processing incoming and outgoing payments
- Cash allocation and account reconciliations
- Billing and invoicing activities
- Producing and issuing statements
- Performing bank reconciliations
- Supporting month-end close processes
- Maintaining accurate financial records
- Building strong working relationships with internal stakeholders and fee earners
- Supporting a busy finance function with a variety of transactional finance duties

Profile

We're keen to speak with candidates who can demonstrate:
- Experience within transactional finance, legal cashiering, accounts payable, accounts receivable or billing
- Strong reconciliation skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Confident communication skills and the ability to work with stakeholders at all levels
- A proactive and inquisitive approach
- Resilience and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
- Strong Excel skills

Legal finance experience would be highly advantageous; however, candidates from professional services or similar transactional finance environments will also be considered.

Job Offer
- Hybrid working with just 1 day per week in the Leeds office
- 35-hour working week
- Flexible start and finish times
- Leeds city centre location
- Immediate start available
- Initial 6-month fixed-term contract
- Strong potential to secure a permanent position

This role would suit someone who enjoys getting involved, asking questions, improving processes and making a genuine impact within a finance team undergoing positive change.

title: Casualty Claims Handler
description:
A renowned National Loss Adjusting Organisation are now seeking an experienced Liability Claims Handler to join their specialist Casualty Liability Team.
- You will handle a variety of specialist Liability claims, predominantly EL & PL and Third-Party Property Damage losses.
- You will manage and be responsible for your own caseload of losses, being part of a dedicated team you will play a vital part of the business by providing an exceptional claims service to key clients.
- Due to growth and expansion this will be an exciting time to join where you will be offered the opportunity to progress and develop long-term.

Key responsibilities:
- Handle predominantly EL & PL claims through to settlement
- Manage your own dedicated caseload of Casualty claims and handling enquiries in relation to policy indemnity, legal liability and quantum
- Liaise with the Insurer, Policyholder and Broker
- Investigate allocated claims, looking at evidence and liaising with all relevant parties and determining liability
- Where appropriate refer to a field adjuster for site investigation to establish how the loss occurred
- Gather all necessary evidence and relevant documentation
- Determine appropriate action for resolution
- Negotiate settlement where appropriate
- Keep up to date with any technical changes within the industry and to your role which may involve participating in training programmes within the company

About you:
- Liability/Casualty Claims handling experience specifically EL & PL (Personal Injury) including Property Damage within the Loss Adjusting, Insurance or Legal Industry
- Experience of handling your caseload of claims through to settlement
- The ability to value an injury loss
- Experience of handling defendant losses
- Excellent communication skills both verbal and written
- Good planning and organisational skills
- Solid IT skills and be able to use multiple in-house systems
- Insurance Industry Qualifications or working towards desirable

Benefits on offer:
- Remote or hybrid depending on location, 35 hours per week Monday to Friday
- Flexible benefits including holiday purchase plan and the opportunity to purchase health cash and BUPA dental plan, flexible working, 5% pension, life assurance 4 x, enhanced maternity, paternity, and adoption pay, discounts with UK retailers, wellbeing hub and many more

title: Claims Handler (Top Insurance Company)
description:
It should be no surprise that when this dynamic insurer decided to build a London Market Claims Team in the UK regions, it plumped for Leeds - it has been established locally for over 20 years, already boasts a significant claims team that comprises many of the region's most gifted insurance professionals, and has recently invested significantly in the acquisition of penthouse offices in perhaps Leeds' most prestigious office addresses.

It is arguably the most exciting insurance company in the market right now, using ingenuity combined with technical expertise and cutting-edge technology to underwrite risks that other insurers shy away from. This 'can do' attitude, coupled with an unwavering focus on client service, is serving it well; the business is currently enjoying 20% year on year growth, and is well on track to exceed its plans to double in size within 5 years.

Working in this new team, you will be handling specialist Professional Indemnity claims from a range of industry sectors such as Solicitors, Architects, Engineers and Consultants. You'll take responsibility for handling a portfolio of high-volume claims from first notification of loss through to final settlement. You'll update in-house and London market claim related systems in relation to individual claims and ensure stakeholders are kept apprised of key developments and key information. In addition, you'll diarise and triage claims as required by the Claims Handling Manual and subject these decisions to regular challenge and review. You'll also develop and maintain excellent working relationships with brokers, as well as working with the Claims Manager on claims initiatives and projects to reach specific goals.

You DO NOT need to have experience in Professional Indemnity claims as full training will be provided. However, you must have some previous experience in insurance claims handling. We are open to experience here and will consider claims specialists from a range of backgrounds, including but not limited to, personal lines, commercial or healthcare insurance. Crucially, you must be well-organised and efficient, with strong communication skills and the ability to analyse claims data in order to spot trends. Just as importantly, you'll have good IT (Microsoft Office) skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook, together with the ability to quickly learn new in-house systems.

Our client is based a stone's throw from Leeds railway station, close to the main public transport links and all the amenities the city centre has to offer. You will be welcome to work from home 1 day per week. In addition to a generous basic salary, you will receive a fantastic benefits package that includes a lucrative bonus and an impressive pension arrangement.

Aston Charles - a personalised service from industry experts

General Insurance and Financial Services Recruitment

title: Sales and Service Advisor
description:
Location: Wakefield

Salary: £27,976 + potential quarterly bonuses up to £4,200

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday - Friday + 1 Saturday every 4 - 6 weeks

Indulge your passion for problem-solving and embrace the thrill of risk management as a Customer Service and Sales Advisor with Gallagher's global brokerage team. Join a diverse family united by excellence, safeguarding businesses and empowering ambitions. You'll receive comprehensive training to help you build a legacy of trust and success in the dynamic world of risk management. We believe every candidate brings something special, so even if you don't feel like an exact match, we encourage you to apply.

How you'll make an impact
- Create insurance quotes and renewals over the phone to provide the best price for our customers, making sure you recommend the right type of cover - always keeping your customers' interests at heart
- Look for all opportunities to upsell or cross-sell our range of products depending on the customers' needs
- Make and answer calls from customers and clients to gather information, provide updates, and talk through any concerns or questions they may have
- Leave the customer happy, with a positive lasting impression and an extraordinary feeling about our products and services
- Balance multiple tasks at the same time, utilising a range of systems and working in a supportive, friendly, and agile team

About you
- No previous insurance experience required
- Ability to explain complex language in simple terms, either in writing and/or over the phone
- Attention to detail because you'll need to accurately review and assess documentation
- Empathy and the ability to remain calm and composed when dealing with customers
- Customer service skills to provide a positive experience for customers throughout
- Computer literate

Benefits
- Comprehensive training scheme with opportunities for career progression and fully funded professional insurance qualifications (CII).
- Minimum of 25 days holiday, plus bank holidays, and the option to 'buy' extra days
- Defined contribution pension scheme, which Gallagher will also contribute to
- Life insurance, which will pay 4x your basic annual salary, which you can top-up to 10x
- Income protection, we'll cover up to 50% of your annual income, with options to top up
- Health cash plan or Private medical insurance
- Three fully paid volunteering days per year
- Employee Stock Purchase plan, offering company shares at a discount
- Discounted gym membership
- Access to a discounted voucher portal to save money on your weekly shop or next big purchase
- Emergency back-up family care

We value inclusion and diversity

Inclusion and diversity are core to Gallagher. For over 95 years, we've committed to sustainability and community support. We value diverse identities, experiences, and talents, enhancing our service to clients and communities.

As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we ensure an inclusive, accessible recruitment process, supporting employees with health conditions or disabilities.

Arthur J. Gallagher Services (UK) Limited is a proud Living Wage employer. We are committed to diversity and equal opportunity for all, opposing any discrimination based on protected characteristics. We provide equal employment opportunities in all aspects of the employer-employee relationship and make reasonable accommodations for disabilities unless it imposes undue hardship.

title: Administrator
company: Practice Plus Group - Health in Justice
advertiser_name: Practice Plus Group - Health in Justice
description: UNLOCK YOUR BEST WORK LIFE + MAKE A DIFFERENCE TO EVERY LIFE We have an exciting opportunity for an Administrator to join the team at HMP Leeds a category B male prison located in Leeds. HMP Leeds is a busy remand prison, so we have a high turnover of men, which makes for a fast paced, challenging, but exciting environment! This role offers a lot of variety, where no 2 days are ever the same - you will be the first point of contact for healthcare! You will work on the wings regularly, interacting with patients during drop in sessions as well as working with the wider prison team. Bespoke induction, including our Introducing Health in Justice training course Competency framework Regional and national career development opportunities Our bespoke Learning Management System to address your learning needs Support from the wider team Candidates are required to have a Legal right to work in the UK and due to the nature of the role, offers of employment will be subject to additional vetting and security checks As our new Administrator, your responsibilities will include: Being the first point of call for the healthcare team, you will respond to emails (Practice Plus Group and NHS), receive and make calls, as well as general admin duties, Arrange and chase referrals and appointments (internal and external), coordinating external hospital appointments alongside the wider prison team, coordinating bed watch in external hospitals, arranging escorts for external appointments etc Working alongside the Patient Engagement Lead, assist with the release and transfer of patients (including follow on care and medication) and much more! Work on the wings for drop in sessions regularly, acting as the admin contact for prisoners and helping them with any healthcare queries, applications or issues Carry out group inductions with new inmates, explaining more about the healthcare service Minute take as necessary If you are interested in career development, we have a wide range of opportunities for you to develop your skills and experience, which include both internal and external options for development and learning. It doesnt stop there we also offer: Company pension scheme 25 days annual leave increasing with service up to 28 days per year, plus public bank holidays An extensive range of wellbeing and lifestyle benefits Discounts on shopping and leisure activities Excellent long-term career prospects 24/7 employee assistance helpline and financial assistance when you need it
